note: Game function signature library. ?? is a wildcard (RIP-relative offsets/immediates). When a game update changes function prologues, reverse-engineer the new addresses and append entries.

hook_addr.note: The first LEA displacement (5A 9B 6D 00, points to message name strings in .rdata) is kept exact to disambiguate from 35 sibling functions with identical prologues.
hook_addr.description: Message dispatcher (high-frequency call point on game thread, injection trigger function)

onopenurl.note: Stack frame size (98 09 00 00 = 0x998) and class field offset (A0 11 00 00) are kept exact to disambiguate from 12 sibling functions with identical prologues.

vtable.note: The OnOpenedWithURL host class vtable is not stored as a signature: at runtime, scan .rdata for entries referencing onopenurl and walk backwards to the vtable start
